# Launch Screen Assets

Generated from `assets/images/icon.svg`. From the repository root, run:

```sh
python3 tool/generate_launcher_images.py
```

Requires Python 3, `rsvg-convert` (librsvg), and `magick` (ImageMagick).
The script also regenerates Android legacy launcher WebP images.
Light and dark variants use the same logo palette on transparent backgrounds.
